scriptLines: gender = iif(     isNull(gender) || trim(gender) == '',     toString(null()),     iif(         upper(trim(gender)) == 'M' || upper(trim(gender)) == 'MALE',         'Male',         iif(             upper(trim(gender)) == 'F' || upper(trim(gender)) == 'FEMALE',             'Female',             toString(null())         )     ) ),

date_of_birth = iif(     isNull(date_of_birth) || trim(date_of_birth) == '',     toDate(null()),     iif(         regexMatch(trim(date_of_birth), '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'),         toDate(             concat(                 iif(                     toInteger(right(trim(date_of_birth), 2)) <= 26,                     '20',                     '19'                 ),                 right(trim(date_of_birth), 2),                 '-',                 left(trim(date_of_birth), 2),                 '-',                 substring(trim(date_of_birth), 4, 2)             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd'         ),         coalesce(             toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),             toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy', 'en-US'),             toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy')         )     ) ),
phone = iif(     isNull(phone) || trim(phone) == '' || lower(trim(phone)) == 'unknown',     toString(null()),     regexReplace(trim(phone), '[^0-9]', '') ),

email = iif(     isNull(email) || trim(email) == '',     toString(null()),     replace(         replace(             replace(                 replace(                     lower(trim(email)),                     'gmail,com',                     'gmail.com'                 ),                 'gmial.com',                 'gmail.com'             ),             ',com',             '.com'         ),         ' at ',         '@'     ) ),
address = iif(     isNull(address) || trim(address) == '',     toString(null()),     trim(address) ),

insurance_provider = iif(     isNull(insurance_provider) || trim(insurance_provider) == '',     toString(null()),     iif(         upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'CIGNA' ||         upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'CIGNA HEALTH',         'Cigna',         iif(             upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'AETNA',             'Aetna',             iif(                 upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'BLUECROSS' ||                 upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'BLUE-CROSS',                 'BlueCross',                 iif(                     upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'MEDICAID',                     'Medicaid',                     iif(                         upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'MEDICARE',                         'Medicare',                         iif(                             upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'UHC' ||                             upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'UNITED HEALTH',                             'United Health',                             iif(                                 upper(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'SELF PAY',                                 'Self Pay',                                 trim(insurance_provider)                             )                         )                     )                 )             )         )     ) )) ~> derivedColumn1
